# Narrative Frame Relation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrativeFrameRelation`](gmeow-NarrativeFrameRelation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrativeFrameRelation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The relationship of one narrative frame to another — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) spanning canon, alternate continuity, expanded universe, fanon, crossover, and adaptation. Non-functional: a frame may hold several relations to another frame from different standpoints.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrativeFrameRelation`](gmeow-NarrativeFrameRelation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
